summary: We (and us) is an index finger that touches one side of your chest and arcs across to touch the other side, including yourself and others.
movement: Arc from one side of the chest to the other
steps: Touch your index finger to one side of your chest.
Arc it across in front of you to touch the other side.
That arc 'collects' you and the people you mean.
mistakes: Pointing straight at the chest. That's I. WE arcs across.
